WHAT YOU CAN DO

A music app.
With the features you need.

Free to install. No account to create.
Built for listening on Android.

Ad-free music

Search and play music without advertising interruptions in Aroha. No subscription is required to use the app.

Background playback

Keep listening when you switch apps or turn the screen off. Control playback from Android’s media controls.

Offline downloads

Save supported songs for offline listening, or import audio already on your device. Availability depends on the source.

Synced lyrics

Read lyrics while your song plays. Choose from four styles, with six providers and automatic fallback when available.

Favorites & playlists

Like songs, create playlists, manage your queue, and back up your library. Listening history and Insights stay on your device.

Make it your own

Choose light, dark or AMOLED appearance. Adjust motion, use a sleep timer, and listen with smooth crossfade.

Playback, lyrics and downloads depend on source availability, network access and content restrictions. Synced lyrics are not available for every song.

COMMON QUESTIONS

About the app.

Need help?
Email the Aroha team.

What is Aroha Music?

Aroha Music is a free, ad-free, open-source YouTube Music alternative for Android. It supports music discovery, background playback, lyrics, playlists and supported offline downloads. Aroha is independent of Google and YouTube.

Is Aroha Music ad-free?

Yes. Aroha provides music playback without advertising interruptions in the app. You do not need a paid subscription or an account to use Aroha. Source availability and content restrictions still apply.

Is Aroha an InnerTune alternative?

Aroha is another option for people looking for an independent Android music app. It offers YouTube Music discovery, ad-free playback, background audio, lyrics and a local library. Aroha is a separate app and is not affiliated with InnerTune.

Can I play music with the screen off?

Yes. Background playback lets music continue when you use another app or turn off your screen. Android battery restrictions and network conditions can affect playback.

Can I download songs for offline listening?

Aroha supports offline downloads where the source permits them, and it can import local audio. Download availability varies by content and provider. Only download media when you have the necessary permission.

Do I need a Google account?

No. Aroha does not require a Google or Aroha account. Account login and cloud sync are not implemented.

Where should I download the APK?

Use the download buttons on this page, which link to the official Aroha GitHub release. Android 8.0 or newer is required. The release page includes release notes, source archives and checksums.

Is this an official YouTube Music app?

No. Aroha is an unofficial, independent client and is not affiliated with Google, YouTube or InnerTune. Playback, artwork and lyrics depend on third-party sources. Aroha is currently available for Android, not iOS or browser streaming.
